SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC:
An ARC-PA site visitor plays a vital role in the accreditation process for Physician Assistant (PA) programs across the nation.
Verification & Validation: They review and confirm the accuracy of information submitted by PA programs in their accreditation materials.
On-Site Evaluation: Through direct observation and interviews with faculty, staff, and students, they assess the program’s compliance with ARC-PA Standards.
Expert Insight: Site visitors are typically experienced PA educators or clinicians who bring professional judgment to evaluate educational quality and institutional readiness.
Reporting: They compile detailed reports that help ARC-PA make informed decisions about a program’s accreditation status.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ORG: Director of Curriculum, Assessment, and Remediation
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC:
The Director of Curriculum, Assessment, and Remediation in the UTRGV Physician Assistant program plays a pivotal role in shaping the academic experience and ensuring student success. Here's an overview of their responsibilities:
Curriculum oversight/designs, updates, and evaluates the PA curriculum to align with accreditation standards (e.g., ARC-PA).
Ensures integration of clinical and didactic components for comprehensive training.
Collaborates with faculty to maintain instructional quality and relevance.
Assessment leadership and develops tools and strategies to measure student learning outcomes.
Oversees exam creation, grading rubrics, and performance benchmarks.
Analyzes data to improve teaching methods and curriculum effectiveness.
Remediation strategy and identifies students needing academic support through performance tracking.
Creates individualized remediation plans to address gaps in knowledge or skills.
Coordinates tutoring, reassessment, and faculty mentorship to help students meet program standards.
Reviewed CASPA applicants and conducted multi-day interviews with students applying to the PA program.
Oversees the department's policies, procedures, and overall program status.

The Student Promotion Committee in our Physician Assistant program plays a critical role in guiding students through their academic journey while upholding the integrity of the program. Monitor Academic Progress: Reviews student performance to ensure they meet benchmarks for advancement through the program. Evaluate Professionalism: Assesses students’ adherence to ethical and professional expectations.
Align all test with specified course objectives and competencies.
Developed remediation policy to be in accordance with the new PA accreditation standards.
